name: Literary text
description: A restrained opening and a comfortable reading column for stories, chapters, and longer creative prose, with optional epigraphs and quiet scene breaks.
structure: A modest centered title sits lower on the opening page, with an optional author line and epigraph.
A narrow column, relaxed leading, and small paragraph gaps support continuous reading.
Optional scene markers stay with their short opening paragraphs; longer passages flow naturally across pages.
Centered page numbers keep navigation quiet. The writing determines its own structure, and the design remains adaptable.
